{"source": "def investigate(context, acquire):
    events = acquire("events")
    seen = set()
    total = 0
    for event in events:
        event_id = event["event_id"]
        if event_id in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(event_id)
        total = total + event["work"]
    return {"findings": [], "unresolved": [], "ratio": total}", "scope": "Deduplicate event records by event_id, summing work once per unique id; duplicate deliveries are ignored, distinct ids with equal work both count.", "lesson": "Deduplication must key on identity (event_id), not on value equality of the payload, so identical work values from different ids are preserved."}
